summary: Iteration 10 formally verified FireStream and database-backed host API-key management. Backend regression: 41/41 pytest tests passed. Admin login returned access_token; authenticated GET /api/hosts exposed only has_api_key booleans; DoodStream, VOE, and FireStream all reported keys present; omitted/empty host-key updates preserved the existing key; new and replaced keys persisted without API leakage; the known FireStream file resolved online with title 'API Upload Test' and a bogus code resolved offline. Desktop Admin UI login, Hosts tab, masked saved-key editor, FireStream provider option, blank-key save, new-host creation/listing, and cleanup all passed. One responsive defect remains: the mobile Admin Hosts page overflows horizontally and places the Add Host button off-screen.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px width the page scrollWidth is 813px and the Add Host button begins at x=492, so the primary action is off-screen. The fixed 256px sidebar and matching main margin leave insufficient content width.

issues: Fixed desktop sidebar and main margin cause severe horizontal overflow.
Admin title, tabs, host cards, and Add Host action are clipped or outside the viewport.

action_items: Make DashboardLayout/AdminDashboard responsive: collapse or hide the fixed sidebar on small screens, remove the fixed main margin, and ensure tabs/cards/actions fit a 390px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard new-host state originally omitted api_key, causing React's uncontrolled-to-controlled input warning when typing a key. Added api_key: '' to emptyHost and confirmed the warning is gone.
server.py is 875 lines, above the 700-line review threshold; split auth, hosts, mirrors, integrations, settings, and seed/background jobs into focused modules.

The DoodStream/VOE key migration only matches api_key fields that do not exist, while FireStream also handles null/empty values. Use the same null/empty-safe migration for all providers so partially migrated records are repaired.
HostInput accepts arbitrary api_provider strings. Constrain it to supported providers (for example a Literal/enum) to reject typos instead of silently falling back to HTTP probing.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested desktop flows passed; mobile responsive check failed)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ FireStream mirrors and host records; all test mirrors and hosts were deleted and deletion was verified. The existing regression fixture also creates TEST_ user records, which cannot be removed through the current API because no user-delete endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 added TestFireStreamAndHostKeys to backend_test.py. Desktop selectors verified: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, admin-tab-hosts, host-editor-modal, host-api-provider, host-api-key-input, save-host-button, add-host-button, and dynamic edit-host-/delete-host- IDs. Backend and desktop feature behavior is green. Recheck the Admin Hosts page at 390x844 after responsive CSS changes.
rca_of_the_issue: The mobile failure is caused by DashboardLayout using a permanently fixed w-64 sidebar and main ml-64 while AdminDashboard retains desktop padding, non-wrapping tabs, and wide cards. At 390px, document width expands to 813px and the Add Host action renders completely beyond the right viewport edge.
